notes.title: First Update for Kharakov
notes.notes:
We present version 2025-08-31 2.4.5-2
It includes the following changes and fixes:


 Additional quests for players and further story progression
 Melee combat system
 Character sheet with an Experience Points–based progression system
 Inventory
 Mechanics dependent on character skills
 Additional dialogue options
 Additional NPCs
 Game save system
 Weather changes
 Numerous improvements in Optimization, Lighting, Sound, Animation, and more
